data.offering_description: Provides merchant payment processing and B2B payment software to small and mid-sized businesses. It processes card and ACH payments and automates business payables, delivered through point-of-sale hardware, software platforms and merchant accounts.

data.primary_products: payment terminals; payment processing software; B2B payment platform

data.primary_services: payment processing; merchant acquiring; accounts payable automation

data.customer_segment: B2B: small and mid-sized merchants, restaurants, healthcare providers, and businesses paying suppliers

data.end_markets: restaurants and hospitality; healthcare; professional services; retail; business-to-business payments

data.revenue_model: transaction or usage fees: card and ACH processing fees charged to merchants and business payers; service fees: software, platform and integration fees

data.value_chain_position: financial intermediary: routes payments between merchants, card networks, banks and suppliers, taking fees on volume; software / platform: sells payment software and payables platforms to businesses

data.geography_served: US national: Nationwide across the United States

data.specialization: related lines: merchant payment processing, B2B payment software, accounts payable automation

data.distribution_channels: direct sales: in-house sales teams selling to merchants and businesses; partners / resellers: independent sales organizations and software integration partners

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: card network rules, PCI data security standards, and banking and money transmission rules

data.primary_products: payment processing platform; card-issuing and digital wallet solutions; point-of-sale and payment acceptance software; virtual cards and payables automation software

data.offering_description: Provides cashless payment, telemetry and micro market software and hardware for unattended retail. Sells to vending, micro market and laundry operators, who use it to take payments and manage machines and inventory remotely.

data.primary_products: payment terminals; telemetry devices; micro market software; vending management software

data.primary_services: payment processing; cloud-based route and inventory management; device deployment and activation

data.customer_segment: B2B: vending operators, micro market operators, laundry operators and other unattended retail businesses

data.end_markets: vending; micro markets; laundry; unattended retail

data.revenue_model: subscription: recurring software and platform fees from operators; transaction or usage fees: payment processing fees on card and mobile transactions; product sales: payment terminals and telemetry devices sold to operators

data.value_chain_position: brand owner: designs and sells payment and telemetry devices made by outside manufacturers, sold to machine operators; software / platform: cloud management platform used by operators, paid through subscriptions; service provider: processes card and mobile payments for operators and takes a fee per transaction

data.geography_served: North America: United States and Canada, with some customers in Europe

data.specialization: related lines: payment hardware, telemetry devices, cloud management software and micro market systems sold to the same operators

data.distribution_channels: direct sales: in-house sales team selling to machine and micro market operators; partners / resellers: channel partners and equipment distributors that bundle the platform with vending machines

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: payment card industry data security standards and US state data privacy laws apply to card processing

data.offering_description: Provides cashless payment hardware, software and managed services for unattended self-service retail such as vending machines, micro markets, kiosks and amusement. Sells to vending operators, convenience service companies and similar merchants, combining card readers, a cloud-based software platform and payment processing.

data.primary_products: card readers and payment terminals; micro market kiosks; point-of-sale hardware

data.primary_services: payment processing; cloud-based inventory and route management software; consumer engagement and loyalty tools; ERP and operations software

data.customer_segment: B2B: vending and micro market operators, convenience services, food service, amusement and laundry businesses

data.end_markets: unattended retail; vending; micro markets; food service; amusement and entertainment

data.revenue_model: subscription: recurring software and device service subscription fees; transaction or usage fees: payment processing fees on card transactions; product sales: card readers, kiosks and POS equipment

data.value_chain_position: software / platform: cloud software platform for operators of self-service retail; financial intermediary: payment processing between consumers, operators and card networks; brand owner: designs payment devices made by contract manufacturers, sold to operators

data.geography_served: North America: United States primarily, with Canada and Europe also served

data.specialization: related lines: payments, hardware, and software for self-service commerce

data.distribution_channels: direct sales: sales team selling to vending operators and enterprise accounts; partners / resellers: channel partners and resellers

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: payment processing subject to PCI DSS, card network rules and money transmission and consumer protection rules
